title: The finishing touch
description: Add eyes to a variety of spawn eggs to give them a sense of spirit
body:
中文：我将1.21.5更新的新刷怪蛋制作了其面部表情，这样让刷怪蛋富有灵气

English：I've taken the new spawn eggs from the 1.21.5 update and made their facial expressions full of vitality！

![It's like this!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/620334a059c030fa868768644dfa78a85b9bf927.png)

中文：我还给一些特殊的刷怪蛋制作了特殊的纹理！

English：I also created special textures for some special spawn eggs!

![It's like this！](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9f07f1e11d7a8af11d0f09bd214e1f4c3335b62.png)
